dataset_name: Expanded Enterprise Knowledge Assistant Evaluation Dataset

corpus.note: Synthetic Contoso portfolio policies; not real company policy.

questions.question: How often must departmental continuity plans be reviewed?
questions.expected_answer: At least annually and whenever a material operational or technology change occurs.

questions.question: What recovery time objective is recommended for critical customer-facing services?
questions.expected_answer: Four hours or less.

questions.question: How often must recovery tests for critical systems be performed?
questions.expected_answer: At least twice per year.

questions.question: Who must review customer notifications before they are distributed?
questions.expected_answer: Legal, Communications, and the accountable business owner.

questions.question: How long are customer support records retained after a case closes?
questions.expected_answer: Three years after the support case is closed, unless a legal hold or contract requires a different period.

questions.question: When must a suspected privacy incident be reported?
questions.expected_answer: Within one hour of discovery.

questions.question: Who approves cross-border transfers of personal data?
questions.expected_answer: The Privacy Office, after review of applicable contractual and legal safeguards.

questions.question: How quickly must requests to access, correct, or delete personal information be forwarded?
questions.expected_answer: Within one business day.

questions.question: After how many calendar days of employment may eligible full-time employees enroll in the group medical plan?
questions.expected_answer: After completing 30 calendar days of employment.

questions.question: How many days do new employees have to submit benefit enrollment selections after their eligibility date?
questions.expected_answer: 15 calendar days.

questions.question: How many confidential wellness counselling sessions may an employee access per calendar year?
questions.expected_answer: Up to four sessions.

questions.question: What is the normal deadline for submitting medical reimbursement claims after discharge or outpatient treatment?
questions.expected_answer: Within 45 calendar days.

questions.question: How many annual leave days does an employee with 4 years of service receive?
questions.expected_answer: 23 working days per year.

questions.question: How far in advance must a request for at least five consecutive annual leave days be submitted?
questions.expected_answer: At least 10 working days in advance.

questions.question: How many paid sick leave days does a full-time employee receive each calendar year?
questions.expected_answer: 10 paid sick leave days.

questions.question: How much paid parental leave is available to a primary caregiver?
questions.expected_answer: 16 weeks paid. HR must be notified at least 8 weeks before the expected start date.

questions.question: What is the company rule for vendor gifts worth more than $50?
questions.expected_answer: They must be declared to HR and may not be accepted without approval.

questions.question: Which approval is required for an expense of $1,800?
questions.expected_answer: Department Director approval.

questions.question: Within how many calendar days should employees normally submit expense reports?
questions.expected_answer: Within 30 calendar days after the transaction date or completion of the business trip, whichever occurs later.

questions.question: At what individual expense amount is an itemized receipt required?
questions.expected_answer: For individual expenses of $25 or more.

questions.question: How often does the normal reimbursement payment cycle run?
questions.expected_answer: Twice per month.

questions.question: What equipment is included in a standard engineering workstation?
questions.expected_answer: One managed laptop, one external monitor, a keyboard, a mouse, and an approved headset.

questions.question: How quickly must a lost or stolen company device be reported to IT Security?
questions.expected_answer: Within one hour of discovery.

questions.question: When may IT Support issue a loan device?
questions.expected_answer: When the primary device cannot be used for more than one business day and suitable stock is available.

questions.question: When must employees normally return assigned devices and accessories?
questions.expected_answer: On their final working day, unless HR approves another date.

questions.question: What is the minimum password length?
questions.expected_answer: At least 14 characters, or a passphrase of four or more unrelated words.

questions.question: After how many failed login attempts is an account locked, and for how long?
questions.expected_answer: After 5 failed attempts, the account is locked for 30 minutes.

questions.question: Which MFA method is approved, and are SMS codes permitted?
questions.expected_answer: The Contoso Authenticator mobile app is approved; SMS-based codes are not permitted.

questions.question: How often are access rights reviewed?
questions.expected_answer: Every quarter.

questions.question: After how many calendar days of employment may a regular full-time employee request role-related external training?
questions.expected_answer: After completing 90 calendar days of employment.

questions.question: What is the standard annual professional development funding limit per eligible employee?
questions.expected_answer: Up to $1,200 per calendar year.

questions.question: How far ahead must an employee submit a training request?
questions.expected_answer: At least 15 business days before the course start date.

questions.question: How soon after a course ends must a completion certificate or attendance record be uploaded?
questions.expected_answer: Within ten business days.

questions.question: How often should managers hold one-to-one performance discussions?
questions.expected_answer: At least once every calendar month.

questions.question: In which months are formal performance reviews normally conducted?
questions.expected_answer: June and December.

questions.question: What does a performance rating of 3 mean?
questions.expected_answer: Performance met the agreed requirements and demonstrated the expected level of role competence.

questions.question: What is the normal duration of a formal performance improvement plan?
questions.expected_answer: 60 calendar days, although HR may approve a different period.

questions.question: Which approval is required for a purchase costing $12,000?
questions.expected_answer: Procurement Director approval.

questions.question: How many vendor quotations are normally required for purchases above $5,000?
questions.expected_answer: At least three written quotations, unless an approved exception applies.

questions.question: Who is authorized to issue an official company purchase order?
questions.expected_answer: Only Procurement.

questions.question: How long must procurement bid documents and related records be retained?
questions.expected_answer: At least seven years.

questions.question: What approvals are required before an employment offer is sent?
questions.expected_answer: Approval from the hiring manager and the authorized HR compensation representative.

questions.question: How many authorized interviewers should participate in the final assessment for regular full-time positions?
questions.expected_answer: At least two.

questions.question: How many business days before joining should equipment and system access requests be submitted?
questions.expected_answer: At least five business days before the joining date.

questions.question: What is the standard probation period for regular new employees?
questions.expected_answer: 90 calendar days, unless the employment agreement specifies another duration.

questions.question: When may an employee request a regular remote work arrangement under the policy?
questions.expected_answer: After completing the initial 90-day probation period, subject to role requirements and manager approval.

questions.question: When should hybrid employees record their planned office and remote days?
questions.expected_answer: By the final working day of the preceding week.

questions.question: How long may a line manager approve temporary remote work outside the normal schedule?
questions.expected_answer: Up to five consecutive working days.

questions.question: How often may managers review remote work arrangements?
questions.expected_answer: Every six months.

questions.question: How many days before departure should business travel be booked whenever possible?
questions.expected_answer: At least 14 days before departure.

questions.question: What is the required flight class for flights shorter than six hours?
questions.expected_answer: Economy class.

questions.question: What is the nightly hotel limit in a high-cost city?
questions.expected_answer: $275 per night.

questions.question: What is the maximum daily meal allowance?
questions.expected_answer: $75 per day in total: breakfast $15, lunch $20, and dinner $40.

questions.question: Within how many business days are approved travel expenses paid?
questions.expected_answer: Within 10 business days of approval.

questions.question: How much cash advance may be requested for an international trip?
questions.expected_answer: Up to $500, requested at least 10 business days before departure; it must be settled within 15 days of returning.

questions.question: What assessments are required before contract signature for a vendor processing confidential data?
questions.expected_answer: An information security assessment is required. If the vendor handles personal data, it must also complete the privacy questionnaire and accept applicable data-processing obligations.

questions.question: How often should business owners review critical vendor performance?
questions.expected_answer: At least quarterly.

questions.question: When must vendor system accounts be disabled after contract completion or removal of access need?
questions.expected_answer: Within one business day.

questions.question: How long does Procurement retain vendor contracts and related risk and performance records?
questions.expected_answer: Seven years.

questions.question: Who should receive a report when an employee discovers a workplace hazard?
questions.expected_answer: Facilities. A high-risk hazard involving immediate danger should be reported to site security or emergency services without waiting for a routine Facilities ticket.

questions.question: How quickly must workplace injuries, near misses, and property damage be reported?
questions.expected_answer: Within one hour of discovery, to the manager and Facilities.

questions.question: May employees use elevators during a fire evacuation?
questions.expected_answer: No, unless the building’s approved emergency procedure specifically permits it.

questions.question: How often should workplace safety inspections occur?
questions.expected_answer: Quarterly.

questions.question: What is the company’s annual bonus percentage for employees rated exceptional?
How many annual leave days are granted to employees after 10 years of service?
questions.expected_answer: 25 working days per year.
